recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser Canvas game titled **Black Flame Party Panic**. Preserve the mechanics of a timed four-item drag-and-drop dressing/assembly loop: four draggable objects spawn along the bottom, each belongs to a specific body slot on a central character, correct placement attaches it, completing all four increments score and adds time, and timeout leads to game over with restart.

Reframe the game as a campy Hocus-Pocus-inspired witchy Halloween party. The central character is a cute Black Flame familiar with a candle flame, stitched cheeks, spooky-cute expressions, and a magical aura. The four items are a sister hat, laughing locket, pumpkin bow, and spark wand. The HUD reads Covens Completed and Candle Time. The scene should be procedural and mobile readable: moon, candles, fog, bunting, pumpkins, spell rings, teal/pink/orange magic, and non-blocking GIF/audio feedback.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The source is a portrait canvas drag-and-drop arcade game. A central plushie waits on screen while four draggable items spawn near the bottom. The player drags each item to a matching body zone. Correct placement attaches the item, creates feedback, and advances progress. Completing all four items sends the character upward, increments score by one, adds a time bonus, and starts the next cycle. If the timer reaches zero, the character enters a short dying animation, then a game-over overlay with restart.

## Protected mechanics
- Pointer/touch drag from lower item row.
- Four item types with four matching slots: head, belly, neck, hand.
- Distance-zone placement thresholds and attach-to-character behavior.
- Countdown, score increment, time bonus, cycle reset, failure, and restart semantics.
- Canvas animation loop and mobile portrait actionability.

## Transformable surfaces
- Character identity and item art.
- HUD labels, objective copy, failure/restart copy.
- Background, particles, palette, typography, GIF labels, and audio framing.

## Remix target
Black Flame Party Panic reframes the plushie assembly loop as a campy witch-sisters Halloween party ritual: drag party charms onto a Black Flame familiar before the candle goes out.
